QuestInfo.name: Keep Your Friends Close
QuestInfo.1: Having justified the Dual Blades, Lady Syl asks you to tell Neinheart about their stance. After her derisive statements about the Knights' sense of justice...can you really trust her?
QuestInfo.2: Lady Syl sent you back to Neinheart after explaining the Dual Blades' position. Her imputance angered Neinheart, but he decided to hold back and keep an eye on them for now.

0.0: Return now, messenger of Cygnus. I know you don't trust us, but don't worry--I take no offense. You will soon learn how strong we are, and then you will be happy to be on our side. Deliver my words to Neinheart.

yes.0: We're all in this together. He needs to remember this.

no.0: Shouldn't you be running back to Neinheart?

1.0: Ah, I've been waiting for you. Report?\r\n#L0##bThey know how we feel, and they don't care. Still, I think we can work together.#l\n#k
1.1: That attitude of theirs still makes me nervous. How can we place our trust in a group with such frivilous goals?\r\n#L0##bLady Syl says our pursuit of justice is no different from their pursuit of strength. I can't agree with them, but as long as we understand their goals, they probably won't betray us.#l\n#k
1.2: To say such a thing...! Lady Syl is not someone we can take lightly. Still, Cygnus wants us to work together, and that's what we will do. I recommend you do not let your guard down around these allies, however.

yes.0: You have performed your duty well. Take this time to rest; we're expecting new orders from the Alliance soon.

npc.0: We're all in this together. Neinheart needs to remember this.
